title: Hold an electricity retail licence
what: Sell electricity to customers only under a retail licence (or an integrated regional licence).

sources.title: Electricity Industry Act 2004 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not sell electricity to customers except under the authority of a retail licence or an integrated regional licence
